Thanks again for the quick loop yesterday. To keep the procurement & legal review tight, we'd like to propose a focused, timeboxed MSA redline session that's designed to:
- surface priority contract items (SLA, data handling, indemnities)
- agree on an action runbook with owners and deadlines
- map which items require follow-up evidence (SOC/Security) vs. doc-only redlines

Proposed format: 45 minutes, agenda-driven (we'll circulate a 1-page runbook pre-read).
I attached a first-pass diff (redwood-msa-diff.pdf) and a suggested compact runbook (runbook-draft.md) — both are intentionally short.

Please pick preferred slots on this Doodle so we can consolidate calendars across legal, procurement, and security: https://doodle.com/poll/abc123-msa-timebox.
We can accommodate CET and UK timezones; let me know if you need APAC windows instead.

Quick asks:
- Who from Ember should join (legal contact + procurement lead + security/compliance)?
- Any hard blackout dates before Sept 8?

If it helps, we can also split into 30/30 (30-minute redline + 30-minute technical onboarding follow-up) but would prefer to keep the initial runbook session tight.

Thanks — I looped Laura and Marissa on internal ops/implementation.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Director, Strategic Accounts
